sources.title: A Generalization of the Skew-Normal Distribution: The Beta Skew-Normal
sources.snippet: The aim of this article is to introduce a new family of distributions, which generalizes the skew normal distribution (SN). This new family, called Beta skew-normal (BSN), arises naturally when we consider the distributions of order statistics of the SN. The BSN can also be obtained as a special case of the Beta generated distribution (Jones (2004)).
